```{python}
# Reads analysis/phase2.py's TSVs from $PHASE2_RESULTS (default ../results/phase2).
# Render: `pixi run report2`, or PHASE2_RESULTS=<dir> quarto render report/phase2.qmd
# Figures: box plots of every individual observation (points) per dataset and size, static
# matplotlib images, one set per Leiden resolution; the resolution slider shows one set at a time.
# The trade-off and threshold views are computed in the page. Formulas are MathML. Plain
# JavaScript, no libraries: one self-contained HTML file that works offline.
import base64
import html
import io
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("../analysis").resolve()))
import figures as fg  # omnicol and the shared figure style

R = Path(os.environ.get("PHASE2_RESULTS", "../results/phase2"))


def tsv(name):
    p = R / f"phase2_{name}.tsv"
    return pd.read_csv(p, sep="\t", dtype={"res_key": str}) if p.exists() else pd.DataFrame()


bounds, runs, stages, obs = tsv("bounds"), tsv("runs"), tsv("stages"), tsv("obs")
pipes, stage_conc = tsv("pipelines"), tsv("stage_concordance")
celltypes, traces = tsv("celltypes"), tsv("traces")
if not len(stages) or "res_key" not in stages.columns or not len(obs):
    raise RuntimeError(f"no per-resolution phase2_stages.tsv / phase2_obs.tsv in {R}: run analysis/phase2.py first")

ORACLE, ANY = "oracle", "*"
MEASURES = ["ari", "jaccard"]  # the partition-agreement toggle
MNAME = {"ari": "ARI", "jaccard": "Jaccard"}
RES_KEYS = [ORACLE] + sorted((k for k in stages["res_key"].unique() if k != ORACLE), key=float)
datasets = sorted(stages["dataset"].unique())
PIPE_ORDER = ["baseline", "scanpy-defaults", "tuned-cpu", "all-gpu", "hybrid"]
PIPE_COLOUR = {p: fg.OMNICOL[i] for i, p in enumerate(PIPE_ORDER)}
MOD_COLOUR = {}
for s_ in ("pca", "knn", "cluster"):
    for i, m in enumerate(sorted(stages.loc[stages["stage"] == s_, "module"].unique())):
        MOD_COLOUR[m] = fg.OMNICOL[i % len(fg.OMNICOL)]
GREYS = ["#8c8b87", "#b0afab", "#6b6a66", "#c8c7c3", "#5e5d59", "#a3a29e", "#3d3c3a", "#d9d8d4"]
STAGE_NAME = {"pca": "PCA", "knn": "kNN", "cluster": "Leiden"}
GPU = lambda k: "rapids" in str(k) or "gpu" in str(k) or k == "hybrid"  # noqa: E731
CELLS = {(r["dataset"], r["subsample"]): r["cells"] for _, r in bounds.iterrows()}


def raw(s):
    """Raw HTML into the page (an `output: asis` cell's printed text)."""
    print(f"\n```{{=html}}\n{s}\n```\n")


def table(df, digits=3, title="Table of medians"):
    """A DataFrame as a plain HTML table, folded away under a summary line."""
    def cell(v):
        if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)):
            return "—" if not np.isfinite(v) else f"{v:.{digits}f}"
        return html.escape(str(v))
    head = "".join(f"<th>{html.escape(str(c))}</th>" for c in df.columns)
    body = "".join("<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{cell(v)}</td>" for v in row) + "</tr>"
                   for row in df.itertuples(index=False))
    raw(f'<details><summary>{html.escape(title)}</summary><div class="tbl"><table><thead><tr>{head}</tr></thead>'
        f'<tbody>{body}</tbody></table></div></details>')


def show(fig):
    """A figure as an embedded PNG (figures.py selects the Agg backend: nothing to display)."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=85)
    plt.close(fig)
    raw(f'<img src="data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()}" style="max-width:100%">')


def plain_log(axis):
    axis.set_major_locator(mticker.LogLocator(subs=(1.0, 2.0, 5.0)))
    axis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v:g}"))
    axis.set_minor_formatter(mticker.NullFormatter())


def boxes(o, ylabel, colours, order=None, logy=False, note=None):
    """Box plots with every observation as a point: one panel per dataset, the sizes along x
    (smallest first), one box per group side by side. GPU groups have dashed boxes; groups
    missing from `colours` are drawn grey (seed floors)."""
    o = o.dropna(subset=["value"])
    if not len(o):
        print("\n_Nothing to show here._\n")
        return
    groups = [g for g in (order or sorted(o["group"].unique())) if g in set(o["group"])]
    greys = {g: GREYS[i % len(GREYS)] for i, g in enumerate(x for x in groups if x not in colours)}
    col = {g: colours.get(g, greys.get(g)) for g in groups}
    n_sizes = max(o.groupby("dataset")["cells"].nunique())
    width = min(18, max(6.5, 0.3 * len(groups) * n_sizes * len(datasets) + 2))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(datasets), figsize=(width, 3.4), sharey=True, constrained_layout=True,
                             squeeze=False)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    w = 0.8 / len(groups)
    for ax, d in zip(axes[0], datasets):
        sub = o[o["dataset"] == d]
        sizes = sorted(sub["cells"].unique())
        for gi, g in enumerate(groups):
            for xi, c in enumerate(sizes):
                v = sub[(sub["group"] == g) & (sub["cells"] == c)]["value"].to_numpy()
                if not len(v):
                    continue
                pos = xi - 0.4 + w * (gi + 0.5)
                bp = ax.boxplot([v], positions=[pos], widths=w * 0.8, patch_artist=True, showfliers=False,
                                medianprops={"color": col[g], "lw": 1.6},
                                boxprops={"facecolor": col[g] + "33", "edgecolor": col[g], "linestyle": "--" if GPU(g) else "-"},
                                whiskerprops={"color": col[g]}, capprops={"color": col[g]})
                ax.scatter(pos + rng.uniform(-w * 0.28, w * 0.28, len(v)), v, s=8, color=col[g], alpha=0.75,
                           zorder=3, linewidths=0)
        ax.set_xticks(range(len(sizes)), [f"{c / 1000:g}k" for c in sizes])
        ax.set_xlim(-0.55, len(sizes) - 0.45)
        ax.grid(axis="x", visible=False)
        for xi in range(1, len(sizes)):
            ax.axvline(xi - 0.5, color="#e4e3df", lw=0.8)
        if logy:
            ax.set_yscale("log")
            plain_log(ax.yaxis)
        ax.set_title(d, loc="left")
        ax.set_xlabel("cells")
    axes[0][0].set_ylabel(ylabel)
    handles = [Patch(facecolor=col[g] + "33", edgecolor=col[g], ls="--" if GPU(g) else "-", label=g) for g in groups]
    fig.legend(handles=handles, loc="outside right center", frameon=False, fontsize=7)
    show(fig)
    if note:
        print(f"\n{note}\n")


def celltype_map(tab, k, groups_order):
    """Per cell type, each group's best-match Jaccard (median over seeds) at each dataset's
    largest size: which cell types each implementation recovers and which it loses."""
    c = celltypes[(celltypes["tab"] == tab) & (celltypes["res_key"] == k)] if len(celltypes) else celltypes
    if not len(c):
        return
    for d in datasets:
        x = c[c["dataset"] == d]
        if not len(x):
            continue
        x = x[x["cells"] == x["cells"].max()]
        m = x.pivot_table(index=["label", "label_cells"], columns="group", values="jaccard")
        m = m.sort_index(level="label_cells", ascending=False)
        m = m[[g for g in groups_order if g in m.columns]]
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.0 + 1.0 * m.shape[1], 1.4 + 0.3 * m.shape[0]), constrained_layout=True)
        im = ax.imshow(m.to_numpy(), aspect="auto", cmap="Blues", vmin=0, vmax=1)
        ax.set_xticks(range(m.shape[1]), m.columns, rotation=30, ha="right", fontsize=7)
        ax.set_yticks(range(m.shape[0]), [f"{lab} ({n:,})" for lab, n in m.index], fontsize=7)
        ax.grid(False)
        if m.size <= 400:
            for (i, j), v in np.ndenumerate(m.to_numpy()):
                if np.isfinite(v):
                    ax.text(j, i, f"{v:.2f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=6,
                            color="white" if v > 0.6 else "#222")
        ax.set_title(f"{d} · {x['cells'].iloc[0] / 1000:g}k cells · per cell type (cells)", loc="left", fontsize=8)
        fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.6, label="Jaccard with best cluster")
        show(fig)


def trace_plot(stage):
    """RAM (solid) and GPU memory (dashed) on the left axis, cores busy (dotted) on the right,
    over the run of one representative job per module."""
    t = traces[traces["stage"] == stage] if len(traces) else traces
    if not len(t):
        print("\n_No denet traces in these results._\n")
        return
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(datasets), figsize=(max(7, 4.6 * len(datasets)), 3.0),
                             constrained_layout=True, squeeze=False)
    seen = {}
    twins = []
    for ax, d in zip(axes[0], datasets):
        x = t[t["dataset"] == d]
        tw = ax.twinx()
        twins.append(tw)
        tw.grid(False)
        for mod, g in x.groupby("module"):
            g = g.sort_values("t_s")
            c = MOD_COLOUR.get(mod, "#52514e")
            seen[mod] = ax.plot(g["t_s"], g["ram_gb"], color=c, lw=1.4)[0]
            if g["gpu_gb"].notna().any():
                ax.plot(g["t_s"], g["gpu_gb"], color=c, lw=1.2, ls="--")
            if "cores" in g and g["cores"].notna().any():
                tw.plot(g["t_s"], g["cores"], color=c, lw=1.0, ls=":", alpha=0.9)
        if len(x):
            ax.set_title(f"{d} · {x['cells'].iloc[0] / 1000:g}k cells", loc="left")
        ax.set_xlabel("time since the job started (s)")
        ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
        tw.set_ylim(bottom=0)
        tw.set_ylabel("cores busy")
    axes[0][0].set_ylabel("memory (GB)")
    top = 1.1 * max(tw.get_ylim()[1] for tw in twins)
    for tw in twins:
        tw.set_ylim(0, top)
    from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
    styles = [Line2D([], [], color="#52514e", lw=1.4, label="RAM (left)"),
              Line2D([], [], color="#52514e", lw=1.2, ls="--", label="GPU memory (left)"),
              Line2D([], [], color="#52514e", lw=1.0, ls=":", label="cores busy (right)")]
    fig.legend([*seen.values(), *styles], [*seen.keys(), *(h.get_label() for h in styles)],
               loc="outside right center", frameon=False, fontsize=7)
    show(fig)
    print("\n_Left axis: RAM of the job's process tree (solid) and GPU memory (dashed). Right axis: cores "
          "busy (dotted; 1 = one core fully used). One job per module: the one with the median wall time at "
          "each dataset's largest size._\n")


def ob(tab, metric, key=ANY):
    return obs[(obs["tab"] == tab) & (obs["metric"] == metric) & (obs["res_key"] == key)]


def per_res(fn, measured=False):
    """fn(res_key) once per resolution (fn(res_key, measure) per resolution and partition
    measure if measured), each in a pane the resolution slider and the measure toggle show or hide."""
    for k in RES_KEYS:
        for m in (MEASURES if measured else [ANY]):
            print(f'\n::: {{.res-pane data-res="{k}" data-measure="{m}"}}\n')
            fn(k, m) if measured else fn(k)
            print("\n:::\n")


def sfx(m):
    return "_jaccard" if m == "jaccard" else ""


def res_text(k, own="each at its own oracle resolution"):
    return own if k == ORACLE else f"at resolution {k}"


def st(stage, k=ORACLE):
    t = stages[(stages["stage"] == stage) & (stages["res_key"] == k)]
    return t.rename(columns={"subsample": "size"}).sort_values(["module", "dataset", "cells"])


def cols(t, names):
    return t[[c for c in names if c in t.columns]]


BOX_NOTE = ("_Box: quartiles and median; whiskers: 1.5 × the box; points: every observation. "
            "Dashed boxes: GPU._")
```

```{python}
# ---- the metric catalogue: one entry per metric, used by the Metrics tab and by every subtab --
M = {}


def metric(key, name, where, what, formula, legend, scale):
    M[key] = dict(name=name, where=where, what=what, formula=formula, legend=legend, scale=scale)


metric("pca_fidelity", "PCA fidelity", "PCA › Accuracy",
       "How much of what the exact PCA captures the method's components capture as well. Each exact "
       "component counts in proportion to the variance it explains, so missing a leading component "
       "costs far more than missing a trailing one. One number per run.",
       r"F = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{k} \lambda_i \,\lVert Q^\top v_i \rVert^2}{\sum_{i=1}^{k} \lambda_i}",
       [("v_i", "the i-th component (unit loading vector) of the exact PCA"),
        ("\\lambda_i", "the variance of the data along that component"),
        ("Q", "an orthonormal basis of the method's k loading vectors"),
        ("\\lVert Q^\\top v_i \\rVert^2", "the share of that component inside the method's subspace (0 to 1)"),
        ("k", "the number of components, 50")],
       "0 to 1; higher is better; 1 = the exact subspace")
metric("pca_agreement", "PCA agreement", "PCA › Stability, Concordance",
       "The same idea between two runs that are both approximate: each run's components scored "
       "against the other's subspace, weighted by its own variances, averaged over the two directions.",
       r"A(a,b) = \tfrac{1}{2}\left[F_a(b) + F_b(a)\right],\quad F_a(b) = \frac{\sum_i \lambda^a_i \lVert Q_b^\top v^a_i \rVert^2}{\sum_i \lambda^a_i}",
       [("a, b", "two PCA runs (two seeds, two folders or two implementations)"),
        ("v^a_i, \\lambda^a_i", "run a's components and their variances"),
        ("Q_b", "an orthonormal basis of run b's loadings")],
       "0 to 1; higher = more alike")
metric("knn_recall", "kNN recall", "kNN › Accuracy",
       "The share of each cell's exact nearest neighbours that the method finds, averaged over cells. "
       "The exact neighbours come from brute force on the same embedding.",
       r"R = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{c=1}^{n} \frac{\lvert N_m(c) \cap N_{\mathrm{ex}}(c) \rvert}{\lvert N_{\mathrm{ex}}(c) \rvert}",
       [("n", "the number of cells"), ("N_m(c)", "the neighbours of cell c found by the method"),
        ("N_{\\mathrm{ex}}(c)", "its exact neighbours")],
       "0 to 1; higher is better; 1 = exact")
metric("knn_shared", "Shared neighbours", "kNN › Stability, Concordance",
       "The share of neighbours two runs give each cell in common, averaged over cells.",
       r"S(a,b) = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{c=1}^{n} \frac{\lvert N_a(c) \cap N_b(c) \rvert}{k}",
       [("N_a(c), N_b(c)", "the neighbours of cell c in runs a and b"), ("k", "the number of neighbours stored per cell")],
       "0 to 1; higher = more alike")
metric("ari", "Adjusted Rand index (ARI)", "Leiden and everything downstream",
       "Agreement between two partitions of the same cells: the share of cell pairs they treat alike "
       "(together in both, or apart in both), corrected so that random partitions score 0.",
       r"\mathrm{ARI} = \frac{\sum_{ij}\binom{n_{ij}}{2} - E}{\tfrac12\left[\sum_i\binom{a_i}{2} + \sum_j\binom{b_j}{2}\right] - E},\quad E = \frac{\sum_i\binom{a_i}{2}\sum_j\binom{b_j}{2}}{\binom{n}{2}}",
       [("n_{ij}", "cells in cluster i of the first partition and cluster j of the second"),
        ("a_i, b_j", "cluster sizes in the first and second partition"), ("n", "the number of cells"),
        ("E", "the value expected for random partitions with these cluster sizes")],
       "−0.5 to 1; 0 = chance, 1 = identical. Coarse partitions agree more easily than fine ones")
metric("accuracy", "Accuracy (share of the oracle)", "every Accuracy subtab, Full pipeline",
       "How well the final clusters recover the reference labels, on a scale from chance to the best "
       "any method could do on this data. The oracle is supervised: a classifier trained on the labels "
       "(cross-validated logistic regression or 15-nearest-neighbour vote on the exact embedding, the "
       "better of the two). An unsupervised pipeline is not expected to reach it.",
       r"\mathrm{acc} = \frac{\mathrm{ARI}(\text{clusters}, \text{labels}) - 0}{O - 0},\quad O = \max(\mathrm{ARI}_{\text{logreg}}, \mathrm{ARI}_{15\text{-NN}})",
       [("\\mathrm{ARI}(\\text{clusters}, \\text{labels})", "the ARI between the run's clusters and the reference labels"),
        ("0", "chance (the ARI of a random partition)"), ("O", "the oracle bound for this dataset and size")],
       "0 = chance, 1 = as good as the oracle; higher is better")
metric("stability", "Stability", "every Stability subtab, Full pipeline",
       "How much the result changes when only a random seed changes: the agreement between every pair "
       "of runs in one output folder that differ only in the seed of the part being studied (one stage "
       "in a stage tab; every stage together in Full pipeline). The box shows all pairs; the summary is "
       "the median. Modules without a seed have no stability, only reproducibility.",
       r"\mathrm{Stab} = \operatorname{median}_{s \neq t}\; \mathrm{sim}(\text{run}_s, \text{run}_t)",
       [("s, t", "two seeds, same folder"), ("\\mathrm{sim}", "the stage's own measure (A, S or ARI) or, downstream, the ARI of the final clusters")],
       "same scale as sim; higher = more stable")
metric("reproducibility", "Reproducibility", "every Stability subtab, Full pipeline",
       "The same seed run again in another output folder: does the identical job give the identical "
       "result? Needs at least two output folders (replicate runs).",
       r"\mathrm{Rep} = \operatorname{median}_{f \neq g}\; \mathrm{sim}(\text{run}^{f}_s, \text{run}^{g}_s)",
       [("f, g", "two output folders"), ("s", "the same seed in both")],
       "same scale as sim; 1 = deterministic")
metric("downstream", "Downstream stability and accuracy", "PCA and kNN › Stability, Accuracy",
       "The effect of a PCA or kNN choice on the final clusters: the rest of the pipeline is held at "
       "the exact baselines with Leiden at seed 0, so any change in the clusters comes from this stage.",
       r"\mathrm{Stab}_{\downarrow} = \operatorname{median}_{s \neq t} \mathrm{ARI}\big(L(\text{stage}_s), L(\text{stage}_t)\big)",
       [("\\text{stage}_s", "the stage's output at seed s"), ("L", "baseline kNN and Leiden (seed 0) applied downstream")],
       "ARI; higher is better")
metric("gap", "Concordance gap", "every Concordance subtab",
       "Do two implementations disagree more than each disagrees with itself? The gap compares the "
       "median agreement between their runs with each one's own seed floor (the median agreement "
       "between its own seeds). No significance test: the size of the gap is the result.",
       r"\mathrm{gap}_A = \operatorname{median}_{s\neq t}\mathrm{sim}(A_s, A_t) - \operatorname{median}_{s,t}\mathrm{sim}(A_s, B_t)",
       [("A_s, B_t", "a run of implementation A at seed s and of B at seed t, on the same upstream, in one folder"),
        ("\\mathrm{gap}_A > 0", "switching to B changes the result more than re-seeding A does")],
       "around 0 = interchangeable; positive = a real difference")
metric("oracle_res", "Oracle resolution", "the resolution slider",
       "The Leiden resolution with the best median accuracy over seeds, chosen once per implementation "
       "or pipeline and dataset size (never per seed). It needs the labels, so a user cannot choose it: "
       "it is the best case. The slider can show any fixed resolution instead.",
       r"r^{*} = \arg\max_{r} \operatorname{median}_{s} \mathrm{ARI}(\text{clusters}_{r,s}, \text{labels})",
       [("r", "a resolution of the sweep"), ("s", "a seed")], "")
metric("wall", "Wall time", "every Cost subtab",
       "Elapsed time of a job from start to end, start-up and imports included, queue excluded, with "
       "empty compilation caches (each job compiles what it needs, as on a first run). Per answer "
       "(Full pipeline): the stages one after another; at a fixed resolution one Leiden run, at the "
       "oracle resolution every resolution of the sweep, since choosing needs them all. The first "
       "rapids job of a module in a folder is a cold start and is left out where there are others.",
       r"T = T_{\mathrm{PCA}} + T_{\mathrm{kNN}} + \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} T_{\mathrm{Leiden}}(r)",
       [("\\mathcal{R}", "one resolution, or the whole sweep at the oracle resolution")],
       "seconds; lower is better")
metric("memory", "Peak memory", "every Cost subtab",
       "The most memory a job held at once, from denet: peak RAM of the job's process tree plus its "
       "peak GPU memory. An answer's peak is the largest of its jobs' (the stages run one after another).",
       r"M = \max_{\text{jobs}} \left(\mathrm{RSS}_{\mathrm{peak}} + \mathrm{GPU}_{\mathrm{peak}}\right)",
       [("\\mathrm{RSS}_{\\mathrm{peak}}", "peak resident memory in RAM, GB"),
        ("\\mathrm{GPU}_{\\mathrm{peak}}", "peak GPU memory, GB (0 for CPU jobs)")],
       "GB; lower is better")
metric("cost", "Effective cost", "Full pipeline › Trade-off and thresholds",
       "Wall time, charged extra for memory above a budget: free up to the budget, proportional above "
       "it, so a pipeline that needs twice the budget costs twice its wall time. The budget is a slider.",
       r"C = T \times \max\!\left(1, \frac{M}{B}\right)",
       [("T", "wall time per answer"), ("M", "peak memory of the answer, GB"), ("B", "the memory budget, GB")],
       "seconds; lower is better")
metric("tradeoff", "Trade-off score", "Full pipeline › Trade-off and thresholds",
       "One number per pipeline, dataset and size combining the three: accuracy and stability on their "
       "0–1 scales, cost as how many times slower than the cheapest pipeline (log10, so 10× slower "
       "costs one point). Absolute scales: a pipeline's score does not change when another is added.",
       r"\mathrm{score} = w_{\mathrm{acc}} \cdot \mathrm{acc} + w_{\mathrm{stab}} \cdot \mathrm{Stab} - w_{\mathrm{cost}} \cdot \log_{10}\frac{C}{C_{\min}}",
       [("w", "the weights (sliders): how much each matters to you"),
        ("C_{\\min}", "the cheapest pipeline's effective cost at that dataset and size")],
       "higher is better")


metric("jaccard", "Best-match Jaccard", "every Stability, Concordance and Accuracy view under the Jaccard toggle",
       "For every cluster of one partition, the overlap with its best-matching cluster in the other, as the "
       "Jaccard index (cells in both ÷ cells in either); averaged over clusters, every cluster counting "
       "the same however small, in both directions. Unlike ARI, which counts pairs of cells and so is "
       "dominated by the largest clusters, a rare cell type that is lost costs as much as a common one. "
       "Splitting a cluster in two halves gives each half 0.5. Always read with the number of clusters.",
       r"J(a,b) = \tfrac{1}{2}\left[\frac{1}{|a|}\sum_{A \in a} \max_{B \in b} \frac{|A \cap B|}{|A \cup B|} + \frac{1}{|b|}\sum_{B \in b} \max_{A \in a} \frac{|A \cap B|}{|A \cup B|}\right]",
       [("a, b", "two partitions of the same cells (two runs, or a run and the reference labels)"),
        ("A, B", "a cluster (a set of cells) of a and of b"), ("|a|", "the number of clusters of a")],
       "0 to 1; 1 = identical; higher is better")
metric("n_clusters", "Number of clusters", "next to every Jaccard view, Accuracy tables",
       "How many clusters the run found. Agreement measures depend on it: coarse partitions agree with "
       "each other more easily, and a partition finer or coarser than the labels cannot match them well.",
       r"K = |\{\text{clusters}\}|", [], "compare with the number of reference labels (Overview)")
metric("celltype", "Per-cell-type recovery", "Clustering › Accuracy and Full pipeline, Jaccard toggle",
       "For every reference cell type, the Jaccard index with the cluster that matches it best, median "
       "over seeds: which cell types an implementation finds and which it splits or merges away.",
       r"J(L) = \max_{B} \frac{|L \cap B|}{|L \cup B|}",
       [("L", "the cells of one reference label"), ("B", "a cluster of the run")], "0 to 1; higher is better")
metric("homcom", "Homogeneity and completeness", "every Accuracy view",
       "Accuracy split into its two ways of failing. Homogeneity: is each cluster made of one cell type? "
       "Completeness: is each cell type in one cluster? Clusters that are too fine stay homogeneous but "
       "lose completeness; too coarse, the reverse. Entropy-based (their harmonic mean is the V-measure).",
       r"h = 1 - \frac{H(L \mid C)}{H(L)}, \qquad c = 1 - \frac{H(C \mid L)}{H(C)}",
       [("L, C", "the reference labels and the clusters"), ("H(L \\mid C)", "the entropy of the labels within clusters"),
        ("H(C \\mid L)", "the entropy of the clusters within labels")], "0 to 1; higher is better")
metric("modularity", "Modularity (optimiser quality)", "Clustering › Accuracy, PCA and kNN downstream, Full pipeline",
       "The objective every Leiden implementation maximises, evaluated for every result on the same graph "
       "(the exact kNN graph of its folder) at the run's own resolution. It answers how well an "
       "implementation optimises what it claims to optimise, and, downstream of an approximate PCA or "
       "kNN, how much the approximation costs on the true graph. Not a measure of biological accuracy; "
       "values at different resolutions are not comparable.",
       r"Q_\gamma = \sum_{C} \left[\frac{w_{\mathrm{in}}(C)}{2m} - \gamma \left(\frac{d(C)}{2m}\right)^2\right]",
       [("C", "a cluster"), ("w_{\\mathrm{in}}(C)", "the weight of edges inside C (each counted twice)"),
        ("d(C)", "the summed degree of its cells"), ("2m", "the total degree of the graph"),
        ("\\gamma", "the resolution the run used")], "higher = a better partition of this graph")
metric("cpu", "CPU time", "every Cost subtab",
       "Processor time the job used, all cores together (denet: CPU use integrated over time, 100 % = one "
       "busy core). What a shared cluster bills for; wall time favours what parallelises, CPU time does not. "
       "GPU work is not in it.",
       r"T_{\mathrm{CPU}} = \int_0^{T} \mathrm{cores}(t)\, dt", [("\\mathrm{cores}(t)", "cores busy at time t")],
       "core-seconds; lower is better")
metric("trace", "Memory and CPU traces", "every Cost subtab",
       "Memory and processor use over the run of one representative job per implementation (the one with "
       "the median wall time, at each dataset's largest size): the shape behind the peak and the CPU time, "
       "such as a spike while loading, a GPU allocation held throughout, or a single busy core.",
       r"\mathrm{RAM}(t),\; \mathrm{GPU}(t),\; \mathrm{cores}(t)",
       [("\\mathrm{cores}(t)", "CPU use at time t / 100 %: 1 = one core fully busy, 8 = eight")], "")
metric("worst", "Worst pair", "the tables of Stability and Full pipeline",
       "The lowest agreement among all pairs of seeds: how far an unlucky seed can take you. Shown next "
       "to the median in the tables; the box plots show all pairs.",
       r"\min_{s \neq t} \mathrm{sim}(\text{run}_s, \text{run}_t)", [], "same scale as the measure")


def explain(*keys):
    """The metrics' description, formula and legend, as used in a subtab."""
    for k in keys:
        m = M[k]
        print(f'\n:::: {{.metric}}\n**{m["name"]}.** {m["what"]}\n\n$${m["formula"]}$$\n')
        if m["legend"] or m["scale"]:
            print("\n::: {.legend}\n")
            for a, b in m["legend"]:
                print(f"- ${a}$: {b}")
            if m["scale"]:
                print(f"\n_Scale:_ {m['scale']}.")
            print("\n:::\n")
        print("\n::::\n")
```

```{python}
# ---- the four subtabs, one function each, the same for every stage ------------------------

MEASURE_NOTE = {"ari": "Partition agreement: **ARI**.", "jaccard": "Partition agreement: **best-match Jaccard**, with the number of clusters."}


def _clusters_box(tab, k):
    boxes(ob(tab, "n_clusters", k), "number of clusters", PIPE_COLOUR if tab == "pipeline" else MOD_COLOUR,
          order=PIPE_ORDER if tab == "pipeline" else None,
          note=f"_Reference labels: {', '.join(f'{d} {n}' for d, n in bounds.groupby('dataset')['labels'].first().items())}._")


def stability(stage):
    if stage == "cluster":
        explain("stability", "ari", "jaccard", "worst")

        def pane(k, m):
            print(f"Leiden at {res_text(k).replace('at ', '')}, on exact PCA and kNN. {MEASURE_NOTE[m]}\n")
            boxes(ob(stage, "downstream_stability" + sfx(m), k), f"stability ({MNAME[m]} between seeds)", MOD_COLOUR,
                  note=BOX_NOTE)
            if len(ob(stage, "downstream_reproducibility" + sfx(m), k)):
                boxes(ob(stage, "downstream_reproducibility" + sfx(m), k), f"reproducibility ({MNAME[m]}, same seed)",
                      MOD_COLOUR)
            if m == "jaccard":
                _clusters_box(stage, k)
            table(cols(st(stage, k), ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "n_clusters",
                                       "downstream_stability", "downstream_stability_min", "downstream_stability_jaccard",
                                       "downstream_reproducibility", "downstream_reproducibility_jaccard"]))
        per_res(pane, measured=True)
        return
    own = "pca_agreement" if stage == "pca" else "knn_shared"
    measure = M[own]["name"].lower()
    explain("stability", own)
    print("#### On the stage's own measure\n")
    boxes(ob(stage, "stage_stability"), f"stability ({measure})", MOD_COLOUR, note=BOX_NOTE)
    t = st(stage)
    nos = sorted(t.loc[t["stage_stability"].isna(), "module"].unique())
    if nos:
        print(f"\n_No seed (exact or deterministic): {', '.join(nos)}. Their run-to-run differences are "
              "reproducibility._\n")
    if len(ob(stage, "stage_reproducibility")):
        boxes(ob(stage, "stage_reproducibility"), f"reproducibility ({measure})", MOD_COLOUR)
    table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "stage_stability", "stage_reproducibility"]))
    print("#### Downstream: the final clusters\n")
    explain("downstream", "jaccard", "worst")

    def pane(k, m):
        res = ("the baseline pipeline's oracle resolution" if k == ORACLE else f"resolution {k}")
        print(f"Leiden at {res}. {MEASURE_NOTE[m]}\n")
        boxes(ob(stage, "downstream_stability" + sfx(m), k), f"downstream stability ({MNAME[m]})", MOD_COLOUR,
              note=BOX_NOTE)
        if m == "jaccard":
            _clusters_box(stage, k)
        table(cols(st(stage, k), ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "n_clusters", "downstream_stability",
                                   "downstream_stability_min", "downstream_stability_jaccard",
                                   "downstream_reproducibility", "downstream_reproducibility_jaccard"]))
    per_res(pane, measured=True)


def _conc(stage, k, measure, m=None):
    sx = sfx(m) if stage == "cluster" else ""
    c = ob(stage, "between" + sx, k)
    floors = ob(stage, ("stage_stability" if stage != "cluster" else "downstream_stability" + sx),
                ANY if stage != "cluster" else k)
    floors = floors.assign(group=floors["group"] + " (own seeds)")
    o = pd.concat([c, floors])
    pairs = sorted(c["group"].unique())
    colours = {p: fg.OMNICOL[i % len(fg.OMNICOL)] for i, p in enumerate(pairs)}
    boxes(o, measure, colours, order=pairs + sorted(floors["group"].unique()),
          note=BOX_NOTE + " _Grey: each implementation's own seed floor._")
    t = stage_conc[stage_conc["stage"] == stage]
    if stage == "cluster":
        t = t[(t["res_key"] == k) & (t["measure"] == m)]
    t = t.rename(columns={"subsample": "size"}).assign(cells=lambda x: [CELLS.get((d, s)) for d, s in zip(x["dataset"], x["size"])])
    table(cols(t.sort_values(["dataset", "cells", "A", "B"]),
               ["dataset", "size", "A", "B", "within A median", "within B median", "between median", "gap A", "gap B"]), 4)


def concordance(stage):
    if not len(ob(stage, "between", ORACLE if stage == "cluster" else ANY)):
        print("_No pairs of implementations here._\n")
        return
    if stage == "cluster":
        explain("gap", "ari", "jaccard")

        def pane(k, m):
            res = "the baseline Leiden's oracle resolution" if k == ORACLE else f"resolution {k}"
            print(f"At {res}, on exact PCA and kNN. {MEASURE_NOTE[m]} Coloured: agreement between two "
                  "implementations (every pair of their seeds).\n")
            _conc(stage, k, MNAME[m], m)
            if m == "jaccard":
                _clusters_box(stage, k)
        per_res(pane, measured=True)
        return
    own = {"pca": "pca_agreement", "knn": "knn_shared"}[stage]
    explain("gap", own)
    print("Coloured: agreement between two implementations (every pair of their seeds, same upstream).\n")
    _conc(stage, ANY, M[own]["name"].lower())


def _accuracy_pane(tab, k, m, colours, order=None, downstream=False):
    pre = "downstream " if downstream else ""
    if m == "ari":
        boxes(ob(tab, "accuracy_share", k), f"{pre}accuracy (ARI, share of oracle)", colours, order=order, note=BOX_NOTE)
    else:
        boxes(ob(tab, "accuracy_jaccard", k), f"{pre}accuracy (Jaccard with the labels)", colours, order=order,
              note=BOX_NOTE)
        _clusters_box(tab, k)
        if not downstream:
            print("\n**Per cell type**\n")
            celltype_map(tab, k, order or sorted(colours))


def _quality_pane(tab, k, colours, order=None):
    """Measure-free views at one resolution: homogeneity, completeness, modularity."""
    print("**Homogeneity and completeness**: which way the clusters miss the labels.\n")
    boxes(ob(tab, "homogeneity", k), "homogeneity (each cluster one cell type)", colours, order=order)
    boxes(ob(tab, "completeness", k), "completeness (each cell type one cluster)", colours, order=order)
    print("**Modularity on the exact kNN graph**, at the run's resolution: how good a partition of the true graph.\n")
    boxes(ob(tab, "modularity", k), "modularity (exact graph)", colours, order=order)


def accuracy(stage):
    if stage == "cluster":
        explain("accuracy", "jaccard", "n_clusters", "celltype", "homcom", "modularity", "oracle_res")

        def pane(k, m):
            print(f"Leiden {res_text(k)}, on exact PCA and kNN. {MEASURE_NOTE[m]}\n")
            _accuracy_pane(stage, k, m, MOD_COLOUR)
            table(cols(st(stage, k), ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "n_clusters", "accuracy_ari",
                                       "accuracy_share", "accuracy_jaccard", "homogeneity", "completeness", "modularity"]))
        per_res(pane, measured=True)
        per_res(lambda k: _quality_pane(stage, k, MOD_COLOUR))
        sl = runs[runs["varies"].isin(["none", "cluster"]) & runs["pca_seed"].astype(str).isin(["0", "nan"])
                  & runs["knn_seed"].astype(str).isin(["0", "nan"])]
        acc = (sl.groupby(["cluster", "dataset", "subsample", "resolution"])["ari_truth"].median()
               .unstack("resolution").reset_index().rename(columns={"cluster": "module", "subsample": "size"}))
        acc = acc.merge(bounds.rename(columns={"subsample": "size"})[["dataset", "size", "cells"]], on=["dataset", "size"])
        acc = acc.sort_values(["module", "dataset", "cells"]).drop(columns="cells")
        acc.columns = [f"res {c:g}" if isinstance(c, float) else c for c in acc.columns]
        table(acc, title="Median ARI against the labels at every resolution (each row's best is its oracle resolution)")
        return
    fid = "pca_fidelity" if stage == "pca" else "knn_recall"
    explain(fid)
    boxes(ob(stage, "fidelity"), "fidelity to exact", MOD_COLOUR, note=BOX_NOTE)
    print("#### Downstream accuracy\n")
    explain("accuracy", "downstream", "jaccard", "homcom", "modularity")

    def pane(k, m):
        res = ("the baseline pipeline's oracle resolution, so another resolution cannot rescue a worse "
               f"{STAGE_NAME[stage]}" if k == ORACLE else f"resolution {k}")
        print(f"Baseline Leiden, seed 0, at {res}. {MEASURE_NOTE[m]}\n")
        _accuracy_pane(stage, k, m, MOD_COLOUR, downstream=True)
        table(cols(st(stage, k), ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "fidelity", "n_clusters",
                                   "accuracy_ari", "accuracy_share", "accuracy_jaccard", "homogeneity", "completeness",
                                   "modularity"]))
    per_res(pane, measured=True)
    per_res(lambda k: _quality_pane(stage, k, MOD_COLOUR))


def cost(stage):
    explain("wall", "cpu", "memory", "trace")
    if stage == "cluster":
        def pane(k):
            print(f"One Leiden run, {res_text(k)}.\n")
            boxes(ob(stage, "cost_s", k), "wall time (s)", MOD_COLOUR, logy=True, note=BOX_NOTE)
            boxes(ob(stage, "cpu_s", k), "CPU time (core-seconds)", MOD_COLOUR, logy=True)
            boxes(ob(stage, "mem_gb", k), "peak memory (GB)", MOD_COLOUR, logy=True)
            table(cols(st(stage, k), ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "cost_s", "cpu_s", "mem_gb"]), 2)
        per_res(pane)
    else:
        boxes(ob(stage, "cost_s"), "wall time (s)", MOD_COLOUR, logy=True, note=BOX_NOTE)
        boxes(ob(stage, "cpu_s"), "CPU time (core-seconds)", MOD_COLOUR, logy=True)
        boxes(ob(stage, "mem_gb"), "peak memory (GB)", MOD_COLOUR, logy=True)
        table(cols(st(stage), ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "cost_s", "cpu_s", "mem_gb"]), 2)
    print("**Memory and CPU over time**\n")
    trace_plot(stage)


def _pipe_intro(k):
    if k == ORACLE:
        print("Each pipeline at **its own oracle resolution**; wall time per answer = PCA + kNN + Leiden at "
              "**every** resolution of the sweep, since choosing the best needs them all.\n")
    else:
        print(f"Every pipeline at **resolution {k}**; wall time per answer = PCA + kNN + **one** Leiden run.\n")


def pipeline_pane(k, m):
    if not len(pipes[pipes["res_key"] == k]):
        print("_No pipeline results at this resolution._\n")
        return
    _pipe_intro(k)
    print(f"{MEASURE_NOTE[m]}\n")
    print("\n**Accuracy**\n")
    _accuracy_pane("pipeline", k, m, PIPE_COLOUR, order=PIPE_ORDER)
    for metric, label in (("stability", "stability (between seeds)"), ("reproducibility", "reproducibility (same seed)")):
        o = ob("pipeline", metric + sfx(m), k)
        if len(o):
            print(f"\n**{label[0].upper() + label[1:]}**\n")
            boxes(o, f"{label.split(' (')[0]} ({MNAME[m]})", PIPE_COLOUR, order=PIPE_ORDER)


def pipeline_pane_free(k):
    p = pipes[pipes["res_key"] == k].rename(columns={"subsample": "size"})
    if not len(p):
        return
    _quality_pane("pipeline", k, PIPE_COLOUR, order=PIPE_ORDER)
    for metric, label in (("cost_s", "wall time per answer (s)"), ("cpu_s", "CPU time per answer (core-seconds)"),
                          ("mem_gb", "peak memory per answer (GB)")):
        o = ob("pipeline", metric, k)
        if len(o):
            print(f"\n**{label[0].upper() + label[1:]}**\n")
            boxes(o, label, PIPE_COLOUR, order=PIPE_ORDER, logy=True)
    table(cols(p.sort_values(["dataset", "cells", "pipeline"]),
               ["pipeline", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "runs", "n_clusters", "accuracy_ari", "accuracy_share",
                "accuracy_jaccard", "homogeneity", "completeness", "modularity", "stability", "stability_min",
                "stability_jaccard", "reproducibility", "reproducibility_jaccard", "cost_s", "cpu_s", "mem_gb"]))
```

## Overview

**Question.** Which PCA → kNN → Leiden pipeline gives the best stability, accuracy and cost, and
how does that change with the number of cells? Where do differences between implementations
come from, stage by stage? And when is a GPU worth it, measured rather than assumed? Plan:
`docs/phase2-plan.md`; every metric is defined in the **Metrics** tab.

**Design.** Each stage tab reads its own slice of the plan: that stage varies, the other two
stay at the exact baselines (covariance-eigh PCA, brute-force kNN, leidenalg run to
convergence) with their seed fixed, so every difference belongs to that stage. The Full
pipeline tab reads five named end-to-end pipelines with matched seeds (seed i at every stage).

| Pipeline | PCA | kNN | Leiden |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | covariance-eigh (CPU) | brute force (CPU) | leidenalg |
| scanpy-defaults | arpack | pynndescent, 1 thread | igraph, 2 iterations |
| tuned-cpu | randomized (CPU) | pynndescent, 8 threads | leidenalg |
| all-gpu | covariance-eigh (GPU) | brute force (GPU) | cuGraph |
| hybrid | covariance-eigh (GPU) | brute force (GPU) | leidenalg |

**Sizes are a nested ladder.** Every size is cut from one fixed ordering of each dataset's cells:
the 5k cells are the first 5,000, the 10k cells the first 10,000 (the same 5,000 plus 5,000 more),
and so on up to all cells. The ordering is stratified by label, so every size keeps each cell
type's share of the whole dataset to within one cell. Differences between sizes are therefore
effects of scale, not of drawing other cells.

```{python}
#| output: asis
folders = runs["run"].fillna("").astype(str).nunique() if len(runs) else 0
print(f"**This report:** {len(runs):,} clusterings, {len(datasets)} dataset(s), {len(bounds)} dataset × "
      f"size combinations, {len(RES_KEYS) - 1} resolutions, {folders} output folder(s)"
      f"{' (same-seed replicates: reproducibility is measured)' if folders > 1 else ' (no replicates: no reproducibility yet)'}.\n")
b = bounds.sort_values(["dataset", "cells"]).rename(columns={
    "subsample": "size", "oracle_logreg": "oracle: logistic regression", "oracle_knn": "oracle: 15-NN",
    "oracle": "oracle (the better)"})[["dataset", "size", "cells", "labels", "chance", "oracle: logistic regression",
                                       "oracle: 15-NN", "oracle (the better)"]]
table(b, title="Datasets, sizes and accuracy bounds")
```

| Subtab | What it shows |
|---|---|
| **Stability** | How much the result changes when only a seed changes (same output folder), and **reproducibility**: the same seed run again in another folder. |
| **Concordance** | How much two implementations disagree, against each one's own seed noise (grey). |
| **Accuracy** | PCA and kNN: **fidelity** to the exact module, and downstream accuracy. Leiden: agreement with the reference labels (ARI as a share of the oracle bound, or Jaccard), homogeneity and completeness, per-cell-type recovery, and modularity on the exact graph. |
| **Cost** | Wall time, CPU time and peak memory of the stage's own job, and memory over time; per answer in Full pipeline. |

**Box plots.** Every figure shows every individual observation as a point (a run, a pair of runs,
a job), grouped into a box per implementation and size: the box spans the middle half, the line
is the median, the whiskers reach 1.5 × the box. The tables of medians fold out under each figure.

**Partition agreement** (top of the page): every comparison of two partitions (stability,
reproducibility and concordance of the clusters, accuracy against the labels) is shown either
as ARI or as best-match Jaccard. The Jaccard views add the number of clusters, which both
measures depend on, and per-cell-type recovery; homogeneity, completeness, modularity and
cost do not depend on the toggle.

**Resolution slider** (top of the page). Leiden runs at every resolution of the sweep; the
slider shows every resolution-dependent result at one of them. At **each method's best
(oracle)**, the PCA and kNN tabs read downstream results at the baseline pipeline's oracle
resolution, so a worse stage cannot be rescued by another resolution, and the Clustering and
Full pipeline tabs read each implementation or pipeline at its own: a choice a user without
labels cannot make. Results that do not depend on Leiden (PCA and kNN on their own measures,
their cost) do not move.

## Full pipeline

The five named pipelines end to end, as in Ben's deck: accuracy over seeds against the chance
and oracle bounds, stability, reproducibility, wall time and peak memory per answer; then one
score and one threshold rule that combine them.

```{python}
#| output: asis
explain("accuracy", "jaccard", "stability", "homcom", "modularity", "wall", "cpu", "memory")
if not len(pipes):
    print("_No named pipelines in these results: run the pipelines slice (scripts/run_pipelines.sh)._\n")
else:
    per_res(pipeline_pane, measured=True)
    per_res(pipeline_pane_free)
```

### Trade-off and thresholds

```{python}
#| output: asis
explain("cost", "tradeoff")
if len(pipes):
    data = pipes.rename(columns={"subsample": "size"})[
        ["res_key", "dataset", "size", "cells", "pipeline", "accuracy_share", "accuracy_jaccard", "stability",
         "stability_jaccard", "cost_s", "mem_gb"]]
    data = json.loads(data.to_json(orient="records"))
    raw("""
<div class="p2-sliders">
<p>Follows the resolution slider and the partition-agreement toggle: with Jaccard, accuracy is
the Jaccard with the labels and stability the Jaccard between seeds. Best per row highlighted.</p>
<label>memory budget B <input type="range" id="w-mem" min="0" max="8" step="1" value="4"> <span></span></label><br>
<label>w<sub>acc</sub> <input type="range" id="w-acc" min="0" max="3" step="0.25" value="1"> <span></span></label>
<label>w<sub>stab</sub> <input type="range" id="w-stab" min="0" max="3" step="0.25" value="1"> <span></span></label>
<label>w<sub>cost</sub> <input type="range" id="w-cost" min="0" max="3" step="0.25" value="1"> <span></span></label>
<div id="p2-trade" class="tbl"></div>
<p><b>Fastest pipeline meeting both thresholds</b> (lowest effective cost C, no weights): accuracy
within the chosen margin of the best pipeline at that dataset and size, and stability at least the
chosen value.</p>
<label>accuracy within <input type="range" id="t-acc" min="0" max="25" step="1" value="5"> <span></span></label>
<label>stability ≥ <input type="range" id="t-stab" min="0.5" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.9"> <span></span></label>
<div id="p2-thresh" class="tbl"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const rows = """ + json.dumps(data) + """;
  const order = """ + json.dumps(PIPE_ORDER) + """;
  const budgets = [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256];
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const fmt = (v, d) => (v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v)) ? "—" : v.toFixed(d);
  const eff = (r, B) => r.cost_s * (isFinite(r.mem_gb) && r.mem_gb !== null ? Math.max(1, r.mem_gb / B) : 1);
  function groups(key) {
    const g = new Map();
    rows.filter(r => r.res_key === key).forEach(r => {
      const k = r.dataset + "|" + r.size;
      if (!g.has(k)) g.set(k, []);
      g.get(k).push(r);
    });
    return [...g.values()].sort((a, b) => a[0].dataset.localeCompare(b[0].dataset) || a[0].cells - b[0].cells);
  }
  function update() {
    const key = window.p2res ? window.p2res() : "oracle";
    const jac = (window.p2measure ? window.p2measure() : "ari") === "jaccard";
    const acc = r => jac ? r.accuracy_jaccard : r.accuracy_share;
    const stab = r => jac ? r.stability_jaccard : r.stability;
    const B = budgets[+$("w-mem").value];
    const w = {acc: +$("w-acc").value, stab: +$("w-stab").value, cost: +$("w-cost").value};
    const t = {acc: +$("t-acc").value, stab: +$("t-stab").value};
    $("w-mem").nextElementSibling.textContent = B + " GB";
    $("w-acc").nextElementSibling.textContent = w.acc;
    $("w-stab").nextElementSibling.textContent = w.stab;
    $("w-cost").nextElementSibling.textContent = w.cost;
    $("t-acc").nextElementSibling.textContent = t.acc + "% of the best";
    $("t-stab").nextElementSibling.textContent = t.stab.toFixed(2);
    const gs = groups(key);
    const names = order.filter(n => rows.some(r => r.pipeline === n));
    let h = "<table><thead><tr><th>dataset</th><th>size</th><th>cells</th>" +
            names.map(n => "<th>" + n + "</th>").join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    gs.forEach(g => {
      const cmin = Math.min(...g.map(r => eff(r, B)).filter(isFinite));
      const score = {};
      g.forEach(r => {
        const s = w.acc * acc(r) + w.stab * stab(r) - w.cost * Math.log10(eff(r, B) / cmin);
        score[r.pipeline] = isFinite(s) ? s : null;
      });
      const vals = Object.values(score).filter(v => v !== null);
      const best = vals.length ? Math.max(...vals) : null;
      h += "<tr><td>" + g[0].dataset + "</td><td>" + g[0].size + "</td><td>" + g[0].cells + "</td>" +
           names.map(n => "<td" + (score[n] !== null && score[n] === best ? ' class="best"' : "") + ">" +
                     fmt(score[n], 3) + "</td>").join("") + "</tr>";
    });
    $("p2-trade").innerHTML = h + "</tbody></table>";
    let k = "<table><thead><tr><th>dataset</th><th>size</th><th>cells</th><th>fastest pipeline</th>" +
            "<th>effective cost (s)</th><th>wall time (s)</th><th>peak memory (GB)</th><th>pipelines meeting both</th></tr></thead><tbody>";
    gs.forEach(g => {
      const bestAcc = Math.max(...g.map(acc).filter(isFinite));
      const ok = g.filter(r => acc(r) >= (1 - t.acc / 100) * bestAcc && stab(r) >= t.stab)
                  .sort((a, b) => eff(a, B) - eff(b, B));
      k += "<tr><td>" + g[0].dataset + "</td><td>" + g[0].size + "</td><td>" + g[0].cells + "</td><td>" +
           (ok.length ? ok[0].pipeline : "none meets both") + "</td><td>" +
           (ok.length ? fmt(eff(ok[0], B), 1) : "—") + "</td><td>" + (ok.length ? fmt(ok[0].cost_s, 1) : "—") +
           "</td><td>" + (ok.length ? fmt(ok[0].mem_gb, 2) : "—") + "</td><td>" + ok.length + "</td></tr>";
    });
    $("p2-thresh").innerHTML = k + "</tbody></table>";
  }
  const prev = window.p2update;
  window.p2update = () => { if (prev) prev(); update(); };
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    ["w-mem", "w-acc", "w-stab", "w-cost", "t-acc", "t-stab"].forEach(id => $(id).addEventListener("input", update));
    update();
  });
})();
</script>""")
```

Every metric in this report: what it measures, how it is computed, and where it appears.

```{python}
                                                  "modularity", "oracle_res"]),
           ("Across stages", ["stability", "reproducibility", "worst", "downstream", "gap"]),

| | Stability | Concordance | Accuracy | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **PCA** | PCA agreement between seeds; downstream ARI or Jaccard | PCA agreement between implementations, gap | PCA fidelity; downstream accuracy, homogeneity, completeness, modularity | wall time, CPU time, peak memory, traces |
| **kNN** | shared neighbours between seeds; downstream ARI or Jaccard | shared neighbours between implementations, gap | kNN recall; downstream accuracy, homogeneity, completeness, modularity | wall time, CPU time, peak memory, traces |
| **Clustering** | ARI or Jaccard between seeds; number of clusters | ARI or Jaccard between implementations, gap | accuracy (ARI share or Jaccard), per cell type, homogeneity, completeness, modularity | wall time, CPU time, peak memory (one Leiden run), traces |
| **Full pipeline** | ARI or Jaccard between seeds (all stages) | — | as Clustering | wall time, CPU time, peak memory per answer; effective cost |
""")
```
